biological_replicate: The control experiment in biological hexuplicate, the PR-619 experiment in biological quintuplicate, and the MG-132 and heat shock experiments in biological triplicate.
technical_replicate: technical replicates per condition (Control: 11, Heat Shock: 6, MG-132: 6, PR-619: 9)

The control condition experiment was performed in biological hexuplicate, and measured as 11 technical replicates. The heat shock experiment was performed in biological triplicate, and measured as 6 technical replicates. The MG-132 experiment was performed in biological triplicate, and measured as 6 technical replicates. The PR-619 experiment was performed in biological quintuplicate, and measured as 9 technical replicates.
experimental_design: Comparison of SUMOylation dynamics under control, heat shock, MG-132 (proteasome inhibitor), and PR-619 (SUMO protease inhibitor) conditions
SUMOylation dynamics were quantitatively studied in response to SUMO protease inhibition, proteasome inhibition and heat shock.
factor_value: The control condition experiment was performed in biological hexuplicate... The heat shock experiment was performed in biological triplicate... The MG-132 experiment was performed in biological triplicate... The PR-619 experiment was performed in biological quintuplicate
number_of_fractions: We analyzed tryptic digests of in-solution digested re-purified SUMOylated peptides by nanoscale LC-MS/MS, without further fractionation
number_of_technical_replicates: measured as 11 technical replicates... measured as 6 technical replicates... measured as 6 technical replicates... measured as 9 technical replicates
number_of_biological_replicates: Quantification was performed over 17 biological replicates, including 6 control, 3 heat shock, 3 MG-132 and 5 PR-619 replicates.
number_of_samples: The control condition experiment was performed in biological hexuplicate, and measured as 11 technical replicates.
